BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC has completed its $250 million share repurchase program, with the second and final tranche concluding on August 27, 2026. Under this final tranche, 6,062,420 ordinary shares were repurchased at an average price of £15.3733, costing £93,199,556.36. In total, since the program's launch on February 26, 2026, Hikma has bought back 13,138,823 shares for £186,264,205.19. Following the cancellation of these repurchased shares, the company will have 208,747,630 ordinary shares in issue. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 28 August 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES AND COMPLETION OF BUYBACK PROGRAMME COMPLETION OF BUYBACK PROGRAMME Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the " Company ") confirms that the second and final tranche (the " Second Tranche ") of repurchases of ordinary shares of 10 pence each pursuant to its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the " Buyback Programme ") has now completed. Following the settlement of the transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares disclosed below (which form part of the Second Tranche), the Company will have purchased under the Second Tranche between 27 May 2026 and 27 August 2026 (inclusive) a total of 6,062,420 ordinary shares at an average price of £15.3733 and a total cost of £93,199,556.36. The Company intends to cancel all ordinary shares purchased under the Second Tranche. The Company is pleased to announce that the Buyback Programme launched on 26 February 2026 is now complete. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 208,747,630 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 208,747,630.
